title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Cover Written Vehicle by Vehicle
content:
**1.** Keyturn Roadside Assistance cover is taken vehicle by vehicle, so a member may hold as many
subscriptions as they have vehicles and there is no ceiling on the number.

**2.** One vehicle carries one live subscription, and a second application on a vehicle already covered
is a plan change on the subscription held rather than a second cover.

**3.** Each subscription carries its own callout allowance, and an allowance unused on one vehicle is
never drawn on for another.

### The same three clauses set out as judgements

| What is before the desk | How it stands under the clauses above |
| --- | --- |
| A member with a further vehicle of their own that carries no cover | A further Keyturn Roadside Assistance subscription may be taken on that vehicle; no ceiling stands on the number a member holds |
| A fresh application on a vehicle that already carries a live subscription | It is a plan change on the subscription that vehicle already holds, not a second cover on the same vehicle |
| Callouts wanted on one covered vehicle while another covered vehicle's allowance stands unused | The allowance of the second vehicle is not drawn on for the first; each subscription's allowance is its own |

### Two worked illustrations

A member holding Keyturn Roadside Assistance on two vehicles brings a third vehicle of theirs that
carries no cover. Clause 1 places no limit on how many subscriptions the member holds, and clause 2 is
not engaged because the third vehicle carries no live subscription, so a third subscription may be
taken on it.

The same member instead brings a fresh application on one of the two vehicles already covered. Clause 2
governs: that vehicle already carries a live subscription, so the application is a plan change on the
subscription held. Clause 3 is unaffected either way, and the allowance standing on the member's other
vehicle is still not available to this one.
